verdict.rationale: Riveter applies AI to your own rows: enrichments fill new columns using AI and web research, and it can add ICP qualifiers and personalized outbound sentences. A search_agent also returns AI-researched answers to single questions. What isn't shown is AI analysis of the dataset as a whole, meaning summaries, patterns or recommendations about your data, so the 'insights and suggestions' part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: dataset-level AI insights or summaries, proactive in-product suggestions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
